description: This file defines the em_discovery_t class, which manages topology discovery messages and analysis in a Wi-Fi mesh network. It includes methods for creating, analyzing, and processing topology messages, as well as virtual functions for hardware-specific operations like sending frames and retrieving MAC addresses.

classes.name: em_discovery_t
classes.description: Abstract class for topology discovery and analysis in Wi-Fi mesh networks, with virtual methods for hardware interaction and message processing.

methods.name: create_topo_discovery_msg
methods.description: Generates a topology discovery message and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_disc_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology discovery message buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_query_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology query message buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_resp_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology response message buffer.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the entity (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_radio_interface_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the radio interface (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_al_interface_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the AL interface (pure virtual).

methods.name: send_frame
methods.description: Sends a data frame over the network (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_current_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the current command being processed (pure virtual).

methods.name: process_msg
methods.description: Processes a message with given data and length.

methods.name: process_state
methods.description: Handles the current state of the system.
